description:
## Goal

After exact wait and activation edges land, remove all scan-era scheduling telemetry and store the remaining causal work-start counts directly in their fixed representation.

## Work

Delete root_scans, drain_discovery_sweeps, ActivationFrontier, demand_on_stall and obsolete APIs/schema/docs already made impossible by fz-kdt.46 and fz-tfn.6. Replace HashMap<WorkStartReason, u64> with the existing fixed WorkStartTally and exhaustive increments after the live reason set is final.

Retain exact work-start causality. Compile-time absence and production boundary tests replace counters that could never observe the work they named.

## Acceptance

No normal-drive discovery scan or scan-era reason remains. Public causal totals retain fidelity for live causes; unchanged and unrelated requests remain zero. Trace compatibility, scheduler/library/matrix/docs/fmt/strict-lint gates pass. Temporary census probes leave.

This ticket absorbs fz-tfn.16.
title: Delete scan-era scheduling and telemetry residue
